svg.title: African countries without a Counter-Strike 2 national qualifier for the 2026 Esports Nations Cup
svg.desc: Rust countries were on the regional lists and were not given a national qualifier. Gold countries were. Western Sahara is gray because it is not in those lists.
svg.text: Who was given a Counter-Strike 2 national qualifier
Esports Nations Cup 2026. One championship place for North Africa. One for Sub-Saharan Africa.
